messages:
maria-g: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: KV-cache eviction + HPA flapping. Need explicit runbook updates: short triage checklist, immediate mitigations, escalation order, and automated vs manual actions. Volunteers?

taylor: I can take the triage checklist and add the short commands. aiming to draft EOD.

nina: i'll own alert thresholds and the decision table (Hosted vs Dedicated). will draft thresholds and approvers.

lee: i'll write the escalation path and fallback steps (who pages, who approves traffic shift).

oncall-bot: Task created: "runbook-update: kv-cache+hpa" assignees: taylor,nina,lee. due: 2026-05-13.

taylor: triage snippet i'll add: 
"kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime"
"curl -s http://runtime-mgr:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache"
"kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector involvedObject.kind=HorizontalPodAutoscaler | tail -n 30"
"if cache miss spike -> kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-mgr -n inference"

nina: draft alert: KVCacheHitDrop if drop > 10% over 30m && P50 latency up 200ms. severity: page. Decision: Dedicated requires product-ops signoff for scale override.

lee: escalation sample: if P95 > 1s OR errors > 3% for 10m -> page @sre-oncall -> if no ack 8m -> page infra-lead -> approve fallback (route 20% to small-pool). fallback must be validated within 10m.

maria-g: please add a small QA checklist before merge: smoke run of commands (non-destructive), test alert fires in staging, and a manual fallback dry-run.

oncall-bot: Follow-up recorded: [runbook draft, alert patch, escalation doc]. owners: taylor,nina,lee. check-in: 2026-05-11.
